verdict.rationale: Qapita is a SaaS cap-table and equity-management platform, so publishing an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence mentions an MCP server or agent connectivity. The llms.txt file is only an LLM-readable content index, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404, so neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
